sql.contact.getById: select c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.date_created, concat(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) as full_name, c.email, c.phone, c.mobile, c.contact_type_id, ct.contact_type, c.company_id, c.street1, c.city, c.state_id, s.state, c.postal_code, c.country_id, ctr.country, c.owner_user_position_id, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(projects))) FROM ( select p.id, p.project_name as "projectName" from flow.project p where p.contact_id = c.id ) projects), '[]') AS "projects", (SELECT row_to_json(o) FROM (SELECT u.id as "userId", u.first_name as "firstName", u.last_name as "lastName", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as "fullName", p.position, up.id as "userPositionId" FROM blueraven."user" u inner join flow.user_position up on up.user_id = u.id inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id WHERE up.id = c.owner_user_position_id) o) AS owner from flow.contact c inner join flow.contact_type ct on ct.id = c.contact_type_id left join flow.state s on s.id = c.state_id left join flow.country ctr on ctr.id = c.country_id where c.id = :contactId
sql.contact.getContactCompanyId: select company_id from flow.contact where id = :primaryId
sql.contact.getByProjectId: select c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.date_created, concat(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) as full_name, c.email, c.phone, c.mobile, c.contact_type_id, c.company_id, c.street1, c.city, c.state_id, s.state, c.country_id, ct.country from flow.contact c inner join flow.project p on p.contact_id = c.id left join flow.state s on s.id = c.state_id inner join flow.country ct on ct.id = c.country_id where p.id = :projectId
sql.contact.updateContact: update flow.contact set contact_type_id = :contactTypeId, first_name = :firstName, last_name = :lastName, street1 = :street1, city = :city, state_id = :stateId, postal_code = :postalCode, country_id = :countryId, phone = :phone, email = :email, mobile = :mobile, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), owner_user_position_id = :ownerUserPositionId where id = :id
sql.contact.insertContact: insert into flow.contact(contact_type_id, first_name, last_name, street1, city, state_id, postal_code, country_id, phone, email, mobile, created_by_id, company_id, owner_user_position_id) values (:contactTypeId, :firstName, :lastName, :street1, :city, :stateId, :postalCode, :countryId, :phone, :email, :mobile, :createdById, :companyId, :ownerUserPositionId)
sql.contact.getOwners: select u.id as "userId", u.first_name, u.last_name, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as full_name, up.id as user_position_id, p.position from flow.owner_position_id op inner join flow.user_position up on array[up.position_id] <@ op.position_ids inner join flow."user" u on u.id = up.user_id inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id inner join flow.company_user_status_type cust on cust.company_id = p.company_id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.company_user_status_type_id = cust.id and ust.user_id = u.id where op.company_id = :companyId and op.owner_type_id = 1 and cust.has_access is true and up.start_date <= now() and (up.end_date is null or up.end_date >= now()) order by u.last_name, u.first_name
sql.contact.updateOwner: update flow.contact set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, owner_user_position_id = :ownerUserPositionId, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.contact.updateMailingAddress: update flow.contact set mailing_street1 = :street1, mailing_street2 = :street2, mailing_city = :city, mailing_state = :state, mailing_postal_code = :postalCode, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.contact.convertToContact: update flow.contact set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, contact_type_id = :contactTypeId, date_modified = now() where id = :contactId
sql.contact.updateGeoLocation: update flow.contact set latitude = :latitude, longitude = :longitude where id = :id
